Tuition Fees and Benefits
If you wish to enrol in a Sapienza degree programme for the 2026–2027 academic year that does not have restricted access, there is still time:
You must sit the TOLC test and pay the €10 fee by Thursday, November 19.
You must pay the first instalment of tuition fees by Wednesday, November 25.
The deadline for paying tuition fees for the second and subsequent years has also been extended to November 25
Full details of payment arrangements and full or partial fee exemptions are available in the 2026–2027 Student regulations

If you are a Studente meritevole ( High school diploma or university degree awarded with the highest grades ), from this academic year onwards you must declare your eligibility status on Infostud before paying your fees.
The maximum tuition fees have remained unchanged from previous years.
Tuition Fees depend on Personal Financial Standing (ISEE)

For students who do not qualify for total exemptions, Sapienza applies a model that allows each student to determine the amount of their own fee - compared to the ordinary measure - in accordance with their financial standing - ISEE for the right to university study (Board of Directors' Resolution of June 11, 2013).

Tuition Payment Deadlines - Academic year 2026/2027
1. Students can pay Sapienza's tuition fee in three instalments. 30% (first instalment), 35% (second instalment) and 35% (third instalment) respectively.

2. Deadlines . For restricted access degree programmes, the deadline for the first instalment is indicated in the call; for degree programmes with admission tests and for those enrolling in years after the first, the deadline is November 5, 2026.

By the same date, you must check with Infostud that the Isee per il diritto allo studio universitario is actually present. If it is not present, even after having carried out the "Upload Isee" operation, you must immediately email your Student affairs office. If you have not acquired the Isee value by December 17, 2026, you will have to pay your tuition fees at the maximum value.

Between December 18, 2026 and June 30, 2027, it will be possible to submit the ISEE value via Infostud after the deadline, but a fine will be incurred. This fine will start at a minimum of €50, increasing by €2.50 for each day of delay up to a maximum of €100.
This fine is in addition to any further penalties for late enrolment fee payments.
3. Late payment penalties. A penalty of €65 applies to late payments; this amount doubles if the delay exceeds 60 calendar days.
a. A penalty of €65 will be imposed on:
anyone paying the first instalment of tuition fees from November 6, 2026 (if the tuition covers years following the first);
anyone paying the second instalment of tuition fees from December 18, 2026;
anyone paying the third instalment of tuition fees from March 26, 2027.
b. A fine of €130 will be imposed on:
those who pay the first instalment of tuition fees from January 4, 2027 (in the case of enrolment for years following the first);
those who pay the second instalment of tuition fees from February 15, 2027;
those who pay the tuition fees for the third instalment from May 25, 2027.
Pay your tuition fees via PagoPA
From March 1, 2021, students enrolled in all our degree programmes must pay their tuition fees via PagoPA, already compulsory for public administrations.
